### T-780 — The reader resumes from a token it has already seen

> _2026-11-24 · core/blong-mle · done_

`core/blong-mle/src/streamSubscribe.ts` adds `subscribeStream`: it reads a response with
`readStream`, yields the values, remembers the token `tokenOf` reports and reopens with it while the
retry budget lasts, skipping a repeat the route did not honour and throwing the last failure once
the budget ends. Exported from the package barrel. Its test lives in
`core/blong-gogo/src/streamSubscribe.test.ts` because `blong-mle` ships no test runner — the same
arrangement the reader itself has (`gatewayStreamRead.test.ts`). 6 assertions, `ci-lint` clean.
